entities.name: Vendidad (Vidēvdād)
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The "Law Against the Demons" (Vidēvdād), one of the 21 nasks (volumes) of the Avesta and the only one to survive intact. Written in Younger Avestan, it comprises 22 chapters (fargards) covering creation myths, the geographic extent of the Zoroastrian world, laws of purity and pollution, funerary practices, penalties for sins, care of animals (especially dogs, sacred in Zoroastrianism), and agricultural regulations. The Vendidad provides the most detailed picture of Zoroastrian ritual law and daily religious practice, paralleling the role of Leviticus in the Hebrew Bible.
